product_metadata.title: iDesign Steel Over-the-Cabinet Towel Holder, The Axis Collection - 3.2" x 1" x 3.7", Bronze
features: OVER THE CABINET TOWEL HOLDER - Designed to be placed over standard-sized cabinet doors, the Axis Collection Towel Hanger Loop provides convenient storage and access to hand and dish towels near the sink

VERSATILE DESIGN & PROTECTIVE BACKING - The versatile hanging design of the hand towel holder keeps towels clean and dry between uses & can be used in the kitchen, pantry, bathroom, or in any room; non-absorbent foam padding protects cabinets from damage
QUICK AND EASY INSTALLATION - No drilling or hardware required; simply place the bathroom towel holder over the cabinet door or the front of a drawer and start using it right away
MADE WITH DURABLE STEEL - Made with durable steel wire construction with a bronze finish, this kitchen towel holder stands up to everyday use and matches a variety of decor styles
COMPACT SIZE - The hand towel holder for bathroom measures 3.2" x 1" x 3.7" and is ideal for adding storage in unused space
description: Organize your home in style with the iDesign Axis Collection Over the Door Towel Holder. This innovative towel holder is designed to be placed over standard-sized bathroom and kitchen cabinet doors to provide convenient storage and access to hand and dish towels near the sink, while the non-absorbent foam padding protects cabinets from scratching and damage. The versatile hanging design of the towel holder for kitchen cabinet keeps towels clean and dry until ready for use and can be used in the kitchen, pantry, bathroom, or in any room around the home. Simply place the kitchen organizer over the cabinet door or the front of a drawer and start using it right away - no drilling or hardware required! The durable steel construction with bronze finish stands up to every day use and matches a variety of decor styles. Measuring 3.2" x 1" x 3.7", this over the door hanger is ideal for adding storage in unused space. With iDesign, you can live simply every day.
